title: Angmngthoo
description: Angmngthoo is a single-level map for Doom II built with brutalist architecture, drawing inspiration from the Quake Brutalist Jam. Titled after a Taiwanese word meaning concrete, the level utilizes OTEX textures and the Eviternity color palette. It features a custom MP3 music track titled 'smell like napalm' composed by the author.

screenshots.caption: Outdoor brutalist courtyard — concrete platforms, sparse trees, grid ceiling.
